verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an email provider, so offline read, search and write with sync on reconnect is a fair axis to judge it on. However, the evidence documents no first-party offline mode or local sync. Its IMAP/SMTP compatibility (agentmail-docs-8) only lets third-party clients like Thunderbird or Outlook supply offline behavior, which is an external-client workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect
